title: Affine leftover hash bound
statement: Let $F$ be a finite field, let $X$ be a probability distribution on $F$, and let $k\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $\Pr[X=x]\le 2^{-k}$ for every $x\in F$. Choose $s=(a,b)$ uniformly from $F^2$, independently of $X$, and output $(s, aX+b)$. The statistical distance between this output distribution on $F^2\times F$ and the uniform distribution on $F^2\times F$ is at most $\frac12\sqrt{|F|\,2^{-k}}$.
